synthesis.body: RETIRED — enforced. lint-spec-status.py collected checklist items with `^##\s+Acceptance Criteria\b` and no re.IGNORECASE, so a spec whose heading read `criteria` collected zero items and invariant (ii) passed vacuously. The matcher now carries re.IGNORECASE, so a lowercase heading is gated like any other and the failure this topic warned about can no longer occur. Retained for a reader who arrives from a stale reference; the successor is the lint itself.

title: `## Acceptance criteria` is silently ungated — lint-spec-status matches case-sensitively
